messages:
Maya: FYI we just finished wiring AWS sandbox 555666 for the marketplace listing but the UI shows the account without any SKUs. Anyone seen a phantom-provision like this?
Diego: common if entitlement sync fails right after role attach. usually IAM propagation lag or missing policy.
Zoe: check the onboarding job logs? It might have returned an empty list instead of retrying.
Maya: logs attached to ticket but short excerpt: `Error: AccessDenied when calling ListEntitlements` from onboarding-worker.
Sam: ops quick fix: add a lightweight gating step in the publish pipeline that verifies `list-entitlements` returns >0 SKUs and that EULA locale fields exist for eu/fr/de before flipping publish flag.
Maya: good call. Legal asked we block publish if localized EULA URLs are absent to avoid compliance delist later.
Diego: for reproducible testing, partners can run this snippet after assume-role:
```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::555666:role/MarketplacePublisherRole --role-session-name test
aws marketplace-entitlement list-entitlements --profile assumed --product-code "redwood-core"
```
Zoe: i'll push a tiny change to onboarding: retry list-entitlements 5 times with exponential backoff and emit metric `marketplace.entitlement.sync.fail`. Also add a one-minute poll for IAM policy attach before first entitlement call.
LegalBot: Reminder: EULA URLs required for EU locales: https://redwood.com/legal/eula-en , https://redwood.com/legal/eula-fr , https://redwood.com/legal/eula-de. Data residency flag must be present for Azure/GCP manifests.
Sam: i'll draft a partner quickstart (terraform snippet + assume-role instructions) and a short troubleshooting checklist: 1) confirm MarketplacePublisherRole present, 2) assume-role & list-entitlements, 3) verify product-code and EULA locales.
ops-bot: Created ticket MP-5010: "Sandbox 555666 - entitlement sync AccessDenied on onboarding" assigned to cloudops. https://issues.redwood.com/MP-5010
Maya: action items: Diego add IAM-poll + retry, Zoe push metric + staging test, Sam add quickstart to partners repo, Legal confirm EULA entries in product manifest. Follow-up here tomorrow 9am PT. :thumbsup:
